metadata.title: Chiaroscuro Portrait with Warm Amber Glow

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key portrait of a man with textured hair and a gold chain, illuminated by a single warm light source from the side, creating deep shadows and a grainy, cinematic atmosphere against a dark amber background.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast lighting defining the facial structure against deep shadows
Warm amber highlights reflecting off the metallic chain and skin
Rough film grain texture unifying the subject and the background
Central subject placement with a slight upward gaze creating a sense of gravitas
coreInvariants: Subject wearing a thick metallic cuban link chain

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The illuminated side of the subject's face and the glint of the gold chain.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright highlight on the nose and cheek, follows the gaze upward, then drops to the reflective chain.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of dark, textured amber space in the upper half and left side of the frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the light source and the deep shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and metallic golds

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family in varying scales for metadata only.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, bold, blocky feel of standard advisory labels.
Provides a clean, professional condensed look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key portrait of a man with short dreadlocks and a thick gold cuban link chain. Use a single warm amber light source from the right side to create a chiaroscuro effect. The background should be a dark, textured amber wall. Apply a heavy film grain texture across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small white rectangular box in the top right corner. Inside the box, place three lines of condensed bold sans-serif text in black, centered. The text should be small and functional.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast with one side of the face in deep shadow?
Is the color palette strictly warm amber and black?
Is there a visible film grain texture?
Is the gold chain reflective and detailed?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the gold chain links
Amount of negative space in the upper frame
mustRedesign: Identifiable facial features of specific celebrities

mustAchieve: Rich metallic sheen on the jewelry
avoid: Vibrant colors outside the amber spectrum

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the shadow side of the face is nearly black.
Check that the grain doesn't obscure the metallic detail of the chain.
Verify the text box is positioned in the extreme top right.
Confirm the subject's gaze is directed slightly upward and away from the lens.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key lighting + Amber color grade + Heavy film grain + Central subject with metallic accessory = Cinematic Portrait Aesthetic
